name: Sour Stingray 86
author: vk-uiux
description: Gradient rounded green radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(to right bottom, hsl(154, 97%, 62%), hsl(225, 97%, 62%)) to hsla(0, 0%, 80%, .14). Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes scale(0), text color changes from hsl(0, 0%, 60%) to hsl(0, 0%, 40%). On focus, background changes from linear-gradient(to right bottom, hsl(154, 97%, 62%), hsl(225, 97%, 62%)) to hsla(0, 0%, 80%, .14).
